title: BBQ A5 Wagyu
summary: Thin, heavily marbled A5 Wagyu on a very hot grill: under two minutes, lid open, with only salt. Slice it into strips to share.

steps.heading: Before you start
steps.text: Take the steak out of the fridge {timer:45} before cooking. Pat it very dry and sprinkle it lightly with salt only. If it already has pepper on it, wipe most of it off: over this heat, with this much fat, pepper scorches and turns bitter.
Preheat the BBQ with the lid closed for {timer:15}, with the hot side as hot as it goes, around {temp:280-300}. Clean the grill and oil it lightly.

steps.heading: Cook
steps.text: Put the Wagyu on the hot grill and leave the lid open: it is so thin that you need to watch it the whole time. Cook for {timer:45s}.
Turn it over, still with the lid open, and cook for another {timer:45s}.
If flames rise from the dripping fat, move the steak away for a few seconds, let them die down, and put it straight back. Do not let the flames burn the meat.
Hold the steak on its fat edge with tongs for {timer:15-20s} to render it, then take it off. It is ready at {temp:50-52!}.

steps.heading: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest it for only {timer:3-4|rest}: being thin, it needs no more.
Slice it into strips about 1 cm wide and finish with a little flaky salt.

tips: If your steak is thicker than about 1.5 cm, give each edge 20-30 seconds on the grill to render the fat.
After resting it settles at 54-56 °C, a beautiful medium-rare.
Salt alone is traditional, and lets the beef speak for itself. Never press it down, and turn it only once.
Cooking it with the fillet: start the fillet first, and put the Wagyu on when the fillet moves to the cooler side. Both are ready to eat at about the same time.
